name: odoo-hackathon
description: Monorepo root – runs backend and frontend simultaneously

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run install:all && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npm run install:all && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
